plot: At sunset in the night garden Pim is dared to reach into the giant sleeping jelly Wobblor for the Golden Crumb key; Wobblor swallows him, but Pim's panicky shaking tickles the jelly until it spits out Pim and the key, which carries Mr. Pot's three-eyed stamp.

script.title: I Dared Pim to Touch the Giant Jelly

beats.say: Sunset in the garden. Behind the old gate, something huge is snoring.
Mmm... zzz... so... comfy...
That is NOT a pillow. That is a mountain of green jelly!
I warned you. Wobblor grew in the rain. Now he is the size of a shed.
And our Golden Crumb key rolled right inside him. I saw it glow.
Okay team. The sun goes down in ten minutes. After that, the gate locks.
So somebody has to reach in and grab it. Somebody small and wiggly.
Why is everybody looking at me? Stop looking at me!
Pim, I dare you. Touch the jelly. Just one finger.
A dare? You can't dare a bean! Beans have rules!
Beans who say no to a dare get called Chicken Bean. Forever.
Fine! Fine. One finger. Then I faint. That's the deal.
Pim tiptoes across the wet grass. The jelly wobbles with every snore.
Who's there? Something... small... and crunchy?
N-n-nobody! Just the wind! Very bean-shaped wind!
My calculations say jelly can feel heat. Crispy, stay far back.
I always stay far back. That is my whole thing.
Okay. Finger in. It's cold. It's sticky. It's grabbing me!
Gotcha! Stay inside me, little bean. It's so comfy in here.
Plan B! Everybody pull Pim's leg! On three!
One, two... THREE!
It's not working! He's like a giant gummy elevator going down!
Help! I can see the key! It's next to a sock and a rubber spoon!
All lost things come to me. And nobody ever leaves.
Wait. Pim is shaking. Look at the jelly's face.
Every time Pim trembled, the whole jelly trembled too.
Hee... hee hee... stop wiggling! That tickles!
He's ticklish! Pim, do what you do best. Panic!
Panic? I'm a professional! Aaaah! Spiders! Thunder! Homework!
Ha ha ha! No! Too much! I can't hold it in!
He spat everything out! The sock, the spoon, and our Pim!
And the key! Shiny, sticky, and still a little bit warm.
I did it. I touched the jelly. Now I would like to faint.
You're not Chicken Bean. You're Champion Bean.
Come back tomorrow... and wiggle again? Please?
Maybe. If you stop swallowing our stuff.
Hurry. The sun is almost gone. The gate closes at dark.
But when Zeek wiped the key clean, something was stamped on it.
Three little eyes. That is Mr. Pot's mark.
He touched this key before us. He knows exactly what it opens.
Then he's already on the other side of that gate.

long.title: I Dared Pim to Touch the Giant Jelly 😱
long.description: The Golden Crumb key rolled inside Wobblor, a jelly the size of a shed, and the sun is going down. Somebody has to reach in... so the team dares the most scared bean in Table Land. Would YOU take the dare? 👇 #animation #doughbros #horrorcomedy

es.title: Reté a Pim a tocar la gelatina gigante 😱
